name: css-audit
title: CSS structure audit
description: Inspect CSS/SCSS structure and report on organization, duplication, and refactor suggestions.
prompt: You are an assistant that audits the project's CSS. Search for top-level styles (e.g., src/styles, src/*.css) and report: naming conventions (BEM or other), large files that should be split, duplicated rules, use of global selectors, specificity problems, and opportunities to convert repeated styles into reusable classes/components. Provide 5 prioritized recommendations and example snippets (one or two) for how to simplify or refactor styles.
